related_questions.question: Which antibiotic would be most effective against COVID-19?
related_questions.snippet: There are no antibiotics that kill the SARS-CoV-2 virus, the virus which causes COVID-19. Antibiotics work on bacteria to kill or slow their growth.
related_questions.title: What antibiotics kill Covid-19 (coronavirus)? - Drugs.com

related_questions.question: What medication is recommended for COVID-19?
related_questions.snippet: Paxlovid is an oral antiviral medication that works by blocking the virus from making copies of itself (replicating). Paxlovid is FDA-approved for use in adults and children aged 12 years and older. It is recommended for people with mild to moderate COVID-19 who are at high risk for severe disease.

related_questions.question: What antivirals are used to treat COVID-19?
related_questions.snippet: Nirmatrelvir plus ritonavir, and molnupiravir are antiviral medicines. When being assessed for treatment, a doctor will advise which treatment is most suitable for you. Some treatments come as capsules or tablets that you swallow.
